What is digital marketing?

Pixelbrahma is a digital marketing agency with offices in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton that plans and manages your online channels and produces the content that makes them work.

Our two digital marketing services

  • Digital Media Managing

    Strategy, platform management, campaign optimisation and analytics, run as a steady monthly rhythm.

    See media managing →

  • Digital Media Content Creation

    Creative content, storytelling, video production and platform-specific posts that people want to watch and share.

    See content creation →

What good digital marketing achieves

  • 01

    Targeted traffic and SEO

    Search optimisation and well-aimed campaigns bring people who are already looking for what you offer.

  • 02

    User experience and conversions

    Marketing only pays off when the landing page is clear. We look at the whole path from first view to enquiry.

  • 03

    Brand awareness and engagement

    Consistent, recognisable content makes your brand familiar and invites conversation.

  • 04

    Long-term growth

    We review results monthly and shift effort toward what works, so gains compound over time.

Mistakes to avoid when planning a digital marketing campaign

Short, practical lessons from projects like yours.

  1. Mistake 1

    Posting on every platform at once

    Do this instead

    Pick the two or three channels where your customers already spend time and do them well.

  2. Mistake 2

    Measuring likes instead of results

    Do this instead

    Agree goals such as enquiries or sales first, then track the numbers that show progress towards them.

  3. Mistake 3

    Changing strategy every few weeks

    Do this instead

    Give each plan a full cycle, review the data monthly and adjust one thing at a time.

What to prepare before we start on a digital marketing campaign

Having these ready lets us give you a sharper estimate and a faster first draft.

Send us your brief
  • Your top business goal for the next six months
  • A short description of your best customers
  • Brand assets, product photos and past campaign material
  • Logins or view access for your existing channels

What decides the cost of digital marketing

We never quote blindly. After a short discovery call we send a written estimate that lists exactly what is included, so you can compare it with confidence.

Get a written estimate
  • +The channels you want to run and how often you need to publish
  • +Design depth: from template-based layouts to fully custom work
  • +Content: whether you supply copy and images or we create them
  • +Timeline: urgent launches need more people working in parallel
  • +Support: a one-off delivery or an ongoing monthly retainer

Digital marketing FAQs

Services, platforms and results, answered.

Ask us directly
What does a digital marketing agency do?

It plans, runs and measures your online promotion, including social media, paid campaigns, content and search, so more of the right people find and trust your brand.

Do I need both media managing and content creation?

They work best together, but you can start with one. Managing keeps channels active and measured, while content creation supplies the creative.

Can you market to audiences in both India and Canada?

Yes. We have teams in both countries and can adapt messaging, timing and channels for each market.

How soon will I see results?

Paid campaigns can show early signals within weeks, while organic growth builds over months. We set realistic expectations in the plan.

Which digital marketing services do you offer?

We offer digital media managing (strategy, platform management, campaign optimisation and analytics) and digital media content creation (creative, video and platform-specific posts).

Do you run Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube marketing?

Yes. We plan and publish content on the platforms where your customers spend time, and we recommend the right mix instead of posting everywhere.

How do you measure digital marketing results?

We agree the goals first, such as reach, enquiries or sales, then report the matching numbers every month with a clear note on what to do next.
